main_recommendation: Keep contemporaneous income out of the main event study; estimate income conditioning as sensitivity only.
reference_design: A2h: current adults age 18+, household reference person/spouse status fixed in event years -3/-2, first biological birth, confirmed-childless controls, IW weights, person and survey-year fixed effects, age and education indicators
income_definition: Family-unit total income in real 2022 USD; tax year equals interview year minus one. No family-size adjustment; no rooms-like date shift.
income_transform: log(INCFAMR) when observed, strictly positive and not top-code marker 9999999
selection_rule: Canonical A2h selection and cohort-reference decisions are computed before restricting to usable income; common arms must share exactly the fitted ID/year keys. Stop if restriction removes reference support.
source_evidence: local Stata metadata labels read on October 1
adoption: No target, weight, model, paper or main event-study specification change.
